name: DUMBBELL HAMSTRING CURL
introduce: Lay prone on the ground. Place a dumbbell between your feet and squeeze your legs together.\n\nBend your knees to bring the dumbbell straight above your knees. Slowly return and repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Don\'t move your hips and your lower back.
Exhale as you bend your knees, and inhale as you return.
This exercise strengthens your hamstrings and will give you healthy and pain-free knees.
